title: Corrupted Wanwood
body:
Description

Corrupted Wanwood is a tree exclusive to the 2025 Halloween Event. It is found all around the Corrupt Biome. Big Bomb Fruit grow on the branches of this tree, which will fall and explode once the tree is cut down. Unlike Corrupt Acacia, Corrupted Cactus, and Corrupt Deadwood, Corrupted Wanwood cannot be made by bringing a regular Wanwood to the Uncertainty Cave and having a mysterious mushroom hit it.
